# env: split configuration by hosts

Let each Mac have its own package list. **Motivation:** "not all mac should be similar by performance reason" — the older machine (`OctoMacLegacy.local` at the time) should not receive the full set of heavy casks and toolchains. Key the configuration on the host name:

```bash
$ uname -n
OctoMacLegacy.local
```
